title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: The practice after a loss
hook: What does practice look like after a tough loss?
intro: Monday practice starts with heavy legs and low spirits.
statement: The practice after a loss sets the tone for the next game.
q1: Do you keep it light and fun to reset —
q2: or work hard on what went wrong?
q3: What does the team need most today?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But kids recover
t2: when practice reminds them why they play.
cta: Coaches — how do you practice after a loss?
ctaLines: Fun games. Fix one thing. Business as usual.
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What does practice look like after a tough loss?
Saturday's game was hard. Monday practice starts with heavy legs and low spirits.
The practice after a loss sets the tone for the next game.
Keep it light or work on what went wrong. Both can work.
How do you practice after a loss? Share your habit in the comments.
